hero.tag: Native VNC & RDP remote desktop client
hero.lead: Connect to any VNC or RDP machine — including a Mac's built-in Screen Sharing — from one small, fast native app. No browser tab, no Electron.
hero.meta: Free and open source · Windows · macOS · Linux
features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
feat.vnc.t: VNC and RDP in one app
feat.vnc.d: VNC with Raw, CopyRect, ZRLE and Tight encodings, and RDP with NLA sign-in and pinned TLS certificates.
feat.mac.t: Works with a Mac's Screen Sharing
feat.mac.d: Sign in with your Mac username and password — no extra software needed on the Mac.
feat.fast.d: Colour depth adapts to your connection and only changed pixels are drawn, so even long-distance sessions stay usable.
feat.multi.d: Keep several machines open and switch instantly. Dropped connections reconnect on their own.
feat.org.d: Colour tags, quick connect, and import or export of your saved connections.
feat.priv.d: Passwords live in your OS keychain, never in a config file.
feat.clip.d: Two-way clipboard sync, full keyboard passthrough and a Ctrl+Alt+Del button.
feat.lang.d: 38 languages, including right-to-left scripts, picked automatically.

dl.title: Download Lupinus
dl.desc: Pick your platform. Every build is made by GitHub Actions and published with checksums.
dl.note: Windows needs WebView2 (included in the installer). Linux needs GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1.
open.title: Free and open source
open.desc: Lupinus is written in Go with Wails and the full source is on GitHub. Bug reports, translations and pull requests are welcome.
